it: \b... Oh, un Allenatore? È ora di lottare?

id: \bYou placed in the Top 8 this year. Come back next year to try again. Thank you for competing.
en: \bYou placed in the Top 8 this year. Come back next year to try again. Thank you for competing.
it: \bQuest'anno sei arrivato tra i migliori 8. Torna l'anno prossimo per riprovarci. Grazie per aver partecipato.

id: \bI never thought you'd become the Monarch.
en: \bI never thought you'd become the Monarch.
it: \bNon avrei mai pensato che saresti diventato il Monarca.

id: \bI can see why you're the Monarch. Keep fighting well.
en: \bI can see why you're the Monarch. Keep fighting well.
it: \bCapisco perché sei il Monarca. Continua a lottare così.

id: \bCongratulations on making it to the Top 8. \nYour next battle will be the Top 4, which is also here.
en: \bCongratulations on making it to the Top 8. \nYour next battle will be the Top 4, which is also here.
it: \bCongratulazioni per essere arrivato nella Top 8. \nIl tuo prossimo incontro sarà nella Top 4, sempre qui.

id: \bTrip: Heh. Can't wait to beat you properly again!
en: \bTrip: Heh. Can't wait to beat you properly again!
it: \bTrip: Heh. Non vedo l'ora di batterti come si deve un'altra volta!

id: \bCongratulations on making it to the Top 4. \nYour next battle will be the Finals, which is also here.
en: \bCongratulations on making it to the Top 4. \nYour next battle will be the Finals, which is also here.
it: \bCongratulazioni per essere arrivato nella Top 4. \nIl tuo prossimo incontro sarà la Finale, sempre qui.

id: \bHey \PN. Glad we get to fight here at the League unlike last time.
en: \bHey \PN. Glad we get to fight here at the League unlike last time.
it: \bEhi, \PN. Sono contento che stavolta possiamo lottare qui alla Lega, a differenza dell'ultima volta.

id: \bGood luck, from one League Champion to the Monarch!
en: \bGood luck, from one League Champion to the Monarch!
it: \bBuona fortuna, da un Campione della Lega al Monarca!

id: \bThat was great. Let's battle again some time.
en: \bThat was great. Let's battle again some time.
it: \bÈ stato fantastico. Lottiamo di nuovo qualche volta.
